author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

LPG Manager LVS IN

**Your role and responsibilities**  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to manage the marketing of ABB’s offerings to targeted market segments and manage the offerings throughout their lifecycle, in line with market needs and division/product group/business line strategy and targets. Each day, you will be accountable for the long-term profitable growth of an offer. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting business results by overseeing each step involved in the offer lifecycle including development, launch, go-to-market, maintenance, pricing, and profitability.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite  
  
**This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Smart Power division at Nashik, India.**

You will be mainly accountable for:

* Leading the market intelligence analysis and identifying potential gaps in the portfolio, with respect to the competition and new market opportunities.
* Owning technical and market specification for the offer and determining an offering business plan that supports sustainable growth while leading customer need and value analysis, planning the roadmap to create maximum value, and following-up on portfolio performance.
* Leading the offer lifecycle management process, analyzing current offers, defining, and tracking performance metrics, and making decisions on offer obsolescence and end-of life to ensure that current and future market requirements are met to maximize their profitability.
* Setting targets, monitoring offering costs and giving inputs to operations functions (e.g., Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Production) to maximize competitiveness and profitability.

**Our team dynamics**

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role**

* **1****5+ years of experience** in Product Management, Product Marketing, or Business Development in **Low Voltage Switchgear industry.**
* **Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (Should be full time)**
* Hands-on experience in New Product Development (NPD) and Product Lifecycle Management.
* Proven expertise in product positioning, pricing strategy, and profitability analysis.
* Experience in product forecasting, inventory planning, and demand management.
* **Strong understanding of LV systems is must** (MCC / PCC / PDP / ACB / MCB / MCCB/ RCCB/ Panels / Breakers)
* Experience working with R&D and engineering teams during product development.
* Exposure to sales enablement, technical support, and customer engagement
* You are at ease communicating in English, with excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**More about us**

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Make your mark by leading a high-visibility modernization that reshapes how teams access trusted insights at scale. You will drive a firmwide legacy analytics decommission and migration, partnering with senior leaders and global delivery teams to deliver measurable outcomes by a strategic deadline. Join a team that values ownership, career mobility, and hands-on impact across a complex technology transformation.

As a Product Manager at JPMorganChase within Commercial & Investment Banking unit, you will lead end-to-end delivery of a legacy business intelligence platform decommission and migration to modern cloud-native analytics tools. You will own inventory analysis, migration planning, and cross-functional execution to move thousands of reports, schedules, and users to approved replacement capabilities. You will partner with technology, data, and business stakeholders to prioritize migration waves, reduce scope through rationalization, and ensure continuity for critical reporting. You will provide transparent governance and executive communications to ensure delivery against a firm strategic deadline.

This role sits within a senior leadership-sponsored transformation program and focuses on retiring legacy reporting capabilities while enabling scalable, modern analytics. You will coordinate across multiple geographies and functions to align business priorities, data dependencies, and delivery sequencing. Success in this role requires strong product ownership, structured program governance, and the ability to translate complex reporting and data flows into actionable migration plans. You will balance speed of delivery with risk awareness, ensuring that regulated or controlled reporting obligations remain continuously supported.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously improve a comprehensive inventory of reports, schedules, and data extract processes, driving rationalization and recertification to reduce migration scope and risk.
* Map report logic and data flows to business processes, application integrations, and downstream dependencies, prioritizing migration waves based on criticality and complexity.
* Lead stakeholder engagement across business and technology functions, facilitating workshops to document current usage, capture requirements, and define future-state reporting needs.
* Define functional and non-functional requirements for replacement reporting capabilities, including scheduling, distribution, embedded analytics, and integration needs.
* Drive evaluation and selection of replacement tools by coordinating structured demos, proof-of-concept activities, and decision forums aligned to program objectives and constraints.
* Oversee migration planning and execution across data warehouse, data pipelines (extract, transform, load), and reporting layers, ensuring source-to-target mapping and semantic definitions are maintained.
* Leverage analytics and approved automation approaches (including responsible use of artificial intelligence-enabled tooling) to accelerate usage analysis, pattern detection, and migration prioritization while maintaining appropriate risk awareness.
* Produce clear program governance artifacts (status reporting, risks/issues/dependencies, milestone tracking, and escalation materials) for senior technology and business leadership.
* Coordinate cross-functional delivery across a global team, proactively surfacing blockers, managing competing priorities, and driving timely decisions.
* Deliver change management activities including user communications, training coordination for new platforms, adoption tracking, and transition support through cutover.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Proven experience as a technical product manager or senior business analyst delivering large-scale technology decommission, data migration, or reporting transformation programs in financial services.
* Demonstrated knowledge of enterprise reporting landscapes, including report lifecycle management, self-service reporting, automated scheduling/distribution, embedded analytics, and integration with data pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise reporting or analytics platform (for example: Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Microsoft Power BI, MicroStrategy, Sigma, Cognos, SAP BusinessObjects, or similar).
* Experience analyzing, rationalizing, and migrating large report inventories, including prioritization, wave planning, and execution tracking.
* Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts (for example: dimensional modeling, facts and dimensions, and data marts) sufficient to assess migration impacts and dependencies.
* Working knowledge of data integration patterns and pipeline scheduling sufficient to document data flows and coordinate re-platforming activities with engineering teams.
* Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL), including complex joins and reconciliations used to validate migration completeness and data quality.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience facilitating workshops, aligning cross-functional priorities, and driving decisions across senior audiences.
* Program governance capability, including structured planning, milestone management, dependency management, and executive-ready communications.
* Awareness of regulated, controlled, or audit-relevant reporting considerations and the need to maintain continuity during platform transitions.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Hands-on experience with SAP BusinessObjects and/or Crystal Reports (for example: Web Intelligence, scheduling, universe design, or report development).
* Experience building dashboards or reports in modern analytics tools (for example: calculations, parameters, filters, and visualization best practices).
* Experience using analytics automation or artificial intelligence-enabled tools (e.g. Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex, ChatGPT/Copilot) to accelerate dataset analysis or workflow efficiency in a controlled enterprise environment.
* Experience with cloud-native data platforms (for example: Snowflake, Databricks, or Google BigQuery) and how reporting tools connect to cloud query engines.
* Experience with SQL performance tuning, data profiling, anomaly detection, and end-to-end data quality validation.
* Experience coordinating user acceptance testing across distributed user groups and supporting structured change management.
* Experience engaging vendors and running structured evaluations, proofs of concept, or request-for-information/request-for-proposal processes.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to help shape and scale our EdTech platform for JEE, NEET, and board-exam aspirants. You will own one or more product areas — learning, assessments, content, or growth — and will drive the roadmap from discovery to launch across web, Android, and iOS. You will work closely with founders, engineering, design, content, and marketing teams to deliver products that measurably improve student outcomes and business metrics.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap for your product area and align it with business, content, and engineering

priorities.

* Talk to students, parents, teachers, and internal teams to deeply understand pain points and

learning behavior.

* Translate insights into clear PRDs, user stories, flows, and acceptance criteria.

* Partner with design on wireframes, prototypes, and user testing; partner with engineering on scope, trade-offs, and delivery.

* Define, instrument, and track success metrics — engagement, retention, conversion, learning outcomes, and revenue.

* Run A/B experiments on pricing, paywalls, onboarding, notifications, and content discovery — and make data-backed calls on what ships.

* Collaborate on our conversion funnel — from YouTube/Shorts traffic to free users to paid course subscribers.

* Own feature launches end-to-end — launch plans, GTM alignment, customer comms, and

post-launch monitoring.

* Prioritize ruthlessly using frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort) and communicate priorities clearly to stakeholders.

* Use product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA, or similar) and work with data/BI to build dashboards for your area.

* Keep a close eye on the competitive landscape (Physics Wallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, etc.) and translate learnings into opportunities.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience in a consumer-facing product (preferably EdTech, mobile, or content platforms).

* Proven track record of shipping features that moved measurable business or user metrics.

* Strong user research skills — interviewing students/users, synthesizing insights, and turning

them into product decisions.

* Strong analytical skills and fluency with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA) and basic SQL for self-serve data pulls.

* Hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests and interpreting results with statistical rigor.

* Experience writing clear PRDs, success criteria, and release plans that engineering and design teams can execute on.

* Strong understanding of conversion funnels, retention, and monetization patterns — especially freemium / tiered pricing.

* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade-offs — APIs, microservices, mobile constraints, performance.

* Experience shipping on mobile-first products (Android and iOS) and understanding

platform-specific nuances.

* Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp one-pager, present to founders, and debate trade-offs clearly.

* Bias for action, high ownership, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in EdTech — particularly JEE/NEET/boards, K-12, or test-prep products.

* Experience building or scaling content-driven products (YouTube/Shorts funnels, creator-led GTM, live classes).

* Experience with assessments and test platforms — question banks, live tests, analytics on

student performance.

* Familiarity with growth loops, referrals, student ambassador programs, and community-led

growth.

* Exposure to live streaming products, push notification strategy, or

personalization/recommendations.

* Prior startup experience — 0®1 product building and operating in early/growth-stage

environments.

* MBA or equivalent structured business education (not required if experience is strong).

**What We're Looking For**

* Student-obsessed — you genuinely care about learning outcomes, not just feature velocity.

* First-principles thinker who can simplify complex problems and drive clarity for the team.

* Comfortable going from strategy to pixel-level detail in the same week.

* Data-driven, but not data-blind — you balance metrics with intuition and user empathy.

* Collaborative leader who earns trust across engineering, design, content, and marketing.

* High-agency — you spot problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

role_title: Technical Product Manager - Lab Automation and Healthcare Solutions / Workflow Consultant
title: Technical Product Manager - Lab Automation and Healthcare Solutions / Workflow Consultant
job_description:
**Job Requirements**  

To promote Lab Automation solutions and improve the productivity and efficiency of laboratory operations in the public and private sectors and facilitate transitional and change management processes for sites converting to a Siemens solution by creating lean laboratory automation designs, transition management processes and implementation expertise, ensuring customer satisfaction and quality throughout the design, implementation and optimization process.

**Product Management (Marketing) components of Role**

**Sales**  

* Support the sales team by becoming involved in the sales process (Blue Sheets, tenders, customer visits).
* Provide relevant scientific, technical information and performing Automation demonstrations / presentations where required.
* Participate in all aspects of new product launches.

**Marketing**  
Spend time in the field understanding market, developing key opinion leaders, coaching sales force in, and validating effectiveness of key messages

**Product Management**  
Assist in the Development and implementation of effective launch plans, key messages, promotional materials, advertising and sales support material for the specified product portfolio (including the effective management of product for promotion and case studies) and consistent with Global Marketing directions.

Stewardship of customer issues with the Global Siemens organization to drive resolution for or understanding of the technical needs of Indian market.

**HCS/ Workflow Components of Role**

As a HCS to effectively satisfy the customer's needs for the optimization of laboratory automation solutions and processes using Siemens proprietary optimization tools and external analytical programs. Ensure any identified defects are followed up internally with the service and applications support teams and lead the team in completing the optimization of the solution using lean methodologies. To occur 6 monthly at all automation sites (or more/less frequently as per customer contract requirements)

Provide laboratory consultative services to current and potential customers to aid in the design of complex laboratory automation solutions. Produce technical CAD drawings (focusing on automation design and services requirements - electrical, pneumatic, water, waste, etc) for complete laboratory solutions and work with project management for costings and implementation planning. Provide detailed transitional processes as part of the solution offering

Maintain personal knowledge of LEAN operational procedures and participate in training courses including classroom attendance, 'self learning', computer based and 'on the job' training.

Ensure any identified defects are followed up internally with the service and applications support teams and lead the team in completing the optimization of the solution using lean methodologies. To occur 6 monthly at all automation sites (or more/less frequently as per customer contract requirements)

Provide laboratory consultative services to current and potential customers to aid in the design of complex laboratory automation solutions. Produce technical CAD drawings (focusing on automation design and services requirements - electrical, pneumatic, water, waste, etc) for complete laboratory solutions and work with project management for costings and implementation planning. Provide detailed transitional processes as part of the solution offering

Maintain personal knowledge of LEAN operational procedures and participate in training courses including classroom attendance, 'self learning', computer based and 'on the job' training.

title: Technical Product Manager (EdTech)
job_description:
**Technical Product Manager**

*Help shape the future of education through technology.*

**About the Role**

Whizara is looking for a driven and experienced **Technical Product Manager** to lead the strategy, development, and continuous improvement of our EdTech platform, connecting students with high-quality teachers and engaging learning experiences.

This is an exciting opportunity for a product professional who understands how to turn business needs, user insights, and technical possibilities into impactful software products.

As our Technical Product Manager, you will take ownership of the product vision, roadmap, and development priorities, working closely with engineering, design, education, and business teams to bring ideas to life. You will play a key role in shaping product decisions, improving platform capabilities, and ensuring that what we build delivers meaningful value to our users.

Experience in **EdTech, particularly in the US K–12 education market, is a significant advantage.** However, we are also open to candidates with a strong Product Management background in SaaS, software, or other technology-driven industries who can demonstrate solid technical understanding, strategic thinking, and the ability to build user-focused products.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Ownership**

* Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with Whizara's business objectives and long-term goals.
* Own the product lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and defining requirements to development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Translate business objectives, customer needs, and user insights into clear product priorities and actionable development plans.
* Evaluate market trends, emerging technologies, and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for product innovation and growth.

**Product Development & Technical Collaboration**

* Work closely with engineering and design teams to define product requirements, prioritize features, and deliver scalable, reliable, and user-friendly solutions.
* Oversee the product development process, ensuring alignment between business requirements, technical feasibility, and user experience.
* Collaborate with engineering teams on technology selection, system architecture considerations, third-party integrations, and platform scalability.
* Drive agile product development practices, including sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and iterative releases.
* Partner with QA teams to establish product quality standards and ensure platform reliability, performance, and usability.

**User Experience & Product Optimization**

* Gather and analyze feedback from students, teachers, educators, and internal stakeholders to identify product needs and improvement opportunities.
* Work with design teams to create intuitive, accessible, and engaging user experiences.
* Use product analytics, performance metrics, and user behavior data to measure product success and guide decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to improve user engagement, platform adoption, operational efficiency, and overall customer satisfaction.

**EdTech & Compliance**

* Collaborate with education experts to ensure that platform features support effective teaching and learning experiences.
* Stay informed about developments in the US K–12 education technology landscape, including relevant educational standards, privacy regulations, and security requirements.
* Help ensure the platform meets applicable data privacy and security requirements, including those relevant to student information.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Education, or a related field.
* Proven experience in Product Management, preferably in a Technical Product Manager, Software Product Manager, or similar product leadership role.
* Experience managing the development and delivery of software products, platforms, or SaaS solutions.
* Strong technical understanding of software development, web technologies, APIs, cloud platforms, and software architecture concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to develop product strategies, manage roadmaps, prioritize backlogs, and translate business requirements into product specifications.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams, particularly engineering, design, QA, and business stakeholders.
* Familiarity with Agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance business objectives, technical considerations, and user needs when making product decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The following would be a strong advantage:

* Experience working in EdTech, particularly with platforms serving the US K–12 education market.
* Familiarity with US K–12 education standards, teaching and learning workflows, and the needs of students, teachers, and schools.
* Understanding of student data privacy and security requirements, including FERPA and COPPA.
* Experience building or managing learning management systems (LMS), student information systems (SIS), tutoring platforms, or other education-related software.
* Experience working with AI-powered products, educational technology, or data-driven learning solutions.
* Background in instructional technology, educational software, or digital learning environments.

**Why Join Whizara?**

* **Make a Meaningful Impact:** Help develop technology that connects students with quality educators and creates better learning opportunities.
* **Own the Product Vision:** Take an active role in shaping the direction, priorities, and evolution of an education technology platform.
* **Work Across Disciplines:** Collaborate with talented professionals in engineering, education, design, and business.
* **Build and Innovate:** Contribute to a growing platform where your ideas and product decisions can make a tangible difference.

**If you're passionate about building great technology products and excited about the opportunity to make an impact in education, we'd love to hear from you!**

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have prior experience with AI-powered EdTech product management?
* What is your availability to start/notice period?
* Are you available to work during US business hours?
* What is your current CTC (in INR)?
* What is your expected CTC (in INR)?

Experience:

* EdTech Product Management: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job profile-**

We are looking for an experienced **Product Manager** to shape the next generation of our time-series data capability.

Across major infrastructure projects, large volumes of sensor, monitoring and operational data are generated over time. Our Timeseries product enables project teams to bring this information together, connect it with other project data, understand trends and changes, and build data-driven applications and services around it.

You will join our digital product and engineering organisation in India and work with colleagues and project teams around the world.

**Role description**

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a product at an important point in its evolution. We have an established legacy platform supporting real projects and customer use cases, alongside a new cloud-based Timeseries product that we are developing for the future.

Your role will be to understand how our customers and project teams use time-series data today, identify their most important needs, and translate those into a clear product strategy and roadmap for the new platform. Your job will not be to recreate the legacy system feature for feature. You will work with customers, project teams, engineers, architects and other Product Managers to determine:

* what should become part of the core Timeseries product;

* what should be redesigned or simplified;

* what should be enabled through APIs, events and integrations;

* how existing projects can safely transition to the new platform;

* and which legacy capabilities can ultimately be retired.

You will be comfortable working in a technically complex environment while keeping the product focused on user needs, reusable capabilities and measurable outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities** **-**

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for our Timeseries product.

* Understand how customers and project teams use time-series, sensor and operational data, and identify the problems that are most valuable for us to solve.

* Lead product discovery with users, project teams, engineers and subject-matter experts, translating their needs into clear product outcomes and priorities.

* Define MVPs and make deliberate decisions about what belongs in the core product and what does not.

* Work closely with the engineering team to maintain a clear, prioritised and delivery-ready product backlog, ensuring upcoming work is understood and aligned to product outcomes.

* Play an active role in the team's agile delivery rhythm, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, maintaining clarity on priorities, outcomes and learning.

* Shape the product capabilities for ingesting, managing, finding, visualising and responding to time-series data, including ingestion, search and alarming.

* Define how Timeseries works with APIs, events and other applications so that specialist project needs don't create unnecessary complexity within the core product.

* Lead the product strategy for transitioning existing projects from our legacy platform, identifying what should be replaced, redesigned, supported differently or retired, and developing a repeatable migration approach.

* Improve onboarding and self-service so project teams can adopt and configure Timeseries without relying on specialist platform knowledge.

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, design and other product teams to turn product direction into delivered customer outcomes.

* Define meaningful measures of product adoption, customer value and migration progress.

* Communicate product direction, priorities, decisions and progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Candidate Specification**

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who enjoys solving complex product problems and is comfortable working with technical products.

You may currently be working with a data platform, IoT product, analytics platform, developer platform, enterprise SaaS product or another technically complex B2B product.

You do not need to be a software engineer or database specialist. However, you should be technically curious and able to work confidently with engineers and architects, understand the implications of different approaches, and turn technical complexity into clear product decisions.

Most importantly, you will bring strong product judgement. You will be comfortable deciding not only what we should build, but also what we should not build.

Your experience is likely to include several of the following:

* Product strategy, discovery and roadmap ownership.

* B2B, enterprise, platform or data product management.

* Understanding customer and user problems through research and discovery.

* Translating complex needs into product outcomes rather than simply collecting feature requests.

* Defining MVPs and making evidence-based prioritisation and scope decisions.

* Working closely with engineering, architecture and design teams.

* APIs, integrations, data pipelines or other technically complex product capabilities.

* Cloud-based software products.

* Managing products with multiple customer or project use cases.

* Communicating complex product decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience leading or contributing to a legacy platform replacement, customer migration, data-platform migration or major product transformation would be particularly valuable.

**Qualifications Preferred** **-**

Experience in some of the following areas would be beneficial, but is not essential:

* time-series databases or time-series data products;

* IoT, sensors, telemetry or operational data;

* Microsoft Azure or other major cloud platforms;

* APIs and SDKs;

* event-driven systems;

* data ingestion and data pipelines;

* data visualisation and analytics;

* alerting or alarming products;

* geospatial or GIS products;

* multi-tenant SaaS or platform products.

We are more interested in finding an excellent Product Manager who is comfortable working with technical products, than somebody who already knows our particular technology stack.

**Further details-**

This role offers the opportunity to shape a product while it is being transformed rather than inheriting one where all the major product decisions have already been made.

You will help us take the best of an established capability, simplify areas that have become complex over time, and establish a modern Timeseries product that can support projects at scale.

You'll have the opportunity to work with real infrastructure use cases and diverse project teams, and to influence how sensor and operational data are used across our digital products in the future.

The successful candidate will ultimately help us answer three important questions:

* What should our Timeseries product become?

* How do we make it simple and valuable for projects to adopt?

* How do we successfully move from the platform we have today to the product we want for the future?

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Ingestion & Customer Onboarding
job_description:
**Job Description:**

The **Senior Product Manager, Data Ingestion and Customer Onboardin**g is responsible for defining the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Vertex's data ingestion and customer onboarding capabilities. This role owns how customer data is collected, transformed, validated, and activated across Vertex products, ensuring customers achieve value quickly and efficiently. Working cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partner teams, this role delivers scalable solutions that improve customer adoption, reduce onboarding complexity, and strengthen platform data capabilities.

* Define and own product vision, strategy, and roadmap for data ingestion and customer onboarding; align priorities with company objectives, customer needs, and platform strategy while balancing strategic investments, customer commitments, and technical debt.
* Own the end-to-end customer onboarding experience from initial setup through successful product adoption; identify friction points, drive improvements that reduce implementation effort, and define success metrics for adoption, activation, and customer health.
* Define capabilities for data ingestion, mapping, validation, transformation, monitoring, and governance; understand integration technologies including APIs, connectors, and ETL/ELT processes to deliver scalable, reusable ingestion services and onboarding automation.
* Translate business requirements into detailed product requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; manage and prioritize the product backlog and partner with Engineering through the full development lifecycle, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release planning.
* Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support teams to continuously improve onboarding outcomes and reduce operational overhead; partner with platform teams to deliver automation and reusable onboarding solutions.
* Engage directly with customers through interviews, workshops, and strategic discussions; demonstrate product capabilities to customers, prospects, and partners; communicate roadmap updates and product outcomes to leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and Engineering teams; build and maintain alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and Partner organizations.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS, enterprise software, platform, or data-centric environment.
* Demonstrated experience building and managing product roadmaps; ability to evaluate trade-offs, assess technical constraints, and prioritize across competing business and customer needs.
* Experience writing detailed product requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; hands-on proficiency with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Working knowledge of data integration concepts including APIs, connectors, and ETL/ELT processes; ability to engage credibly with Engineering teams on data ingestion and platform integration topics.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; demonstrated ability to evaluate complex trade-offs and make prioritization decisions grounded in data and customer impact.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to present priorities, roadmap decisions, and product outcomes clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Product organizations to deliver cross-functional outcomes.

Job Description – Product Manager (1–2 Years of Experience)

Job Title: Product Manager

Experience: 1–3 years

Location: Bangalore

Work Mode: Work from Office

Employment Type: Full-time

About SnapBizz

SnapBizz is India's leading digital commerce platform for Kirana stores, enabling retailers to digitize their businesses through smart billing, inventory management, customer engagement, supplier management, and data analytics. With a presence across 50,000+ stores in 42+ cities, SnapBizz connects Kirana stores with brands, distributors, wholesalers, financial institutions, and consumers, creating a seamless FMCG ecosystem. Headquartered in Bengaluru, SnapBizz is transforming traditional retail through technology and innovation.

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Product Manager with 1–2 years of experience to join our product team. The candidate will work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and business teams to understand customer needs, define product requirements, and support the development and launch of successful products.

The ideal candidate should have strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and project coordination skills, along with an understanding of the product development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

1.

Gather and analyze customer requirements, feedback, and market research.

2.

Work with stakeholders to understand business needs and product objectives.

3.

Create and maintain product roadmaps, feature lists, and product documentation.

4.

Write Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria.

5.

Collaborate with UI/UX designers to develop user-friendly product experiences.

6.

Coordinate with engineering teams to ensure timely product delivery.

7.

Prioritize product features based on business impact and customer requirements.

8.

Monitor product performance using KPIs and analytics tools.

9.

Conduct competitor analysis and identify market opportunities.

10.

Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have as a Product Manager?
* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?
* Are you an immediate joiner?
* What is your notice period?

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Why N-able:

At N-able, we’re not just helping businesses be secure —we’re redefining what it means to be cyber resilient. Our end-to-end platform blends AI-powered capabilities and flexible tech stacks, so customers can manage, secure, and recover with confidence. But the real power behind it all? Our people. We’re a global crew of N-ablites, who love solving complex problems, sharing knowledge, and delivering solutions that actually make a difference. If you're into meaningful work, fast growth, and a team that’s got your back, you’ll be surrounded by people who believe in what they do—and in you.

What You'll Do:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a defined area spanning network discovery and asset monitoring, including its roadmap and delivery. Network discovery is about finding and mapping the devices and assets in a customer's environment. Asset monitoring covers monitoring for security, device health, and device observability. The two connect closely, since you can only monitor what you can see, but each is an area in its own right with its own problems, users, and roadmap. You'll work with the guidance of a Principal PM or product leadership on strategy, and you'll be trusted to run day-to-day execution on your own.

N-able PMs are full-stack PMs. You'll partner closely with engineering on what gets built and why, but the job doesn't stop at the backlog. You're expected to understand how MSPs operate, how customer environments are built and monitored, the competitive landscape, and where the technology is heading, and to bring that into decisions others can act on. You'll regularly be in front of partners and customers.

Product areas at N-able are flexible. As priorities and the market evolve, the areas our PMs own can change, and your focus may shift or broaden over time. We're looking for someone who sees that as an opportunity to grow.

  

* Own the roadmap and delivery for your area across network discovery and asset monitoring, contributing to its strategy and covering the lifecycle from discovery to launch.
* Translate MSP problems around device discovery, network visibility, security monitoring of assets, device health, observability, alerting, and noise reduction into clear product requirements, epics, and user stories, and explain the tradeoffs behind them.
* Make sure what gets discovered feeds what gets monitored, so that discovery and monitoring work as a coherent experience for the technician while each keeps its own roadmap.
* Partner day to day with engineering and architecture to deliver capabilities that measurably improve discovery coverage, monitoring coverage and accuracy, time to detect device issues, time to onboard, and technician efficiency.
* Run continuous discovery with MSP partners, internal IT teams, and prospects, separating what people ask for from what they actually need.
* Track the competitive landscape (RMM, network discovery and monitoring, asset monitoring, observability, ITOM) for your area and feed it into positioning and roadmap decisions.
* Build reliability, scalability, security, performance, and ease of use into product design, particularly for monitoring at scale across many customer environments.
* Define and track success metrics for your area, such as adoption, retention, and monitoring coverage, and act when they move the wrong way.
* Work with product marketing, sales, and support on launches, enablement, webinars, and analyst or customer briefings.
* Take on new or changing product areas as priorities shift, bringing your learning and good practice with you.
* Support and informally mentor newer product managers, sharing good practice with the team.

What You'll Bring:

* 7+ years in product management, including at least 2 years on SaaS products in IT management, network management, monitoring, or related infrastructure domains.
* Technical background in IT infrastructure, endpoint, and network management technologies, and a strong understanding of how MSPs manage IT for their customers.
* Self-motivation and comfort with ambiguity and change. You can take a loosely defined problem, make decisions, communicate them, and follow through with moderate supervision, and you adapt well when your area of focus shifts.
* Strong product sense: good instincts for what to build, what to cut, and what "good" looks like for a technician managing many customer environments under time pressure.
* A track record of shipping SaaS products in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and clear, professional communication with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree; a Master's degree is preferred.

**Big Pluses**
--------------

* Hands-on experience with network discovery, network or asset monitoring, RMM, observability, or ITOM tools, as a product manager, practitioner, or administrator.
* Working knowledge of discovery and monitoring technologies (e.g., SNMP, WMI, flow data, topology mapping, asset inventory, agent-based and agentless monitoring, telemetry).
* Understanding of security monitoring of assets, such as configuration and patch posture, vulnerability exposure, or endpoint security signals.
* Direct experience managing and monitoring production infrastructure.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Network+, CCNA, Security+) or a background in IT operations, network engineering, or security.
* Experience building AI-powered product capabilities, such as anomaly detection or intelligent alerting.

Purple Perks:

* Group Medical , Personal Accident & Term life coverage
* Generous PTO and observed holidays
* 2 Paid VoluNteer Days per year
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* FuN-raising opportunities as part of our giving program
* N-ablite Learning – custom learning experience as part of our investment in you
* The Way We Work – our hybrid working model based on trust and flexibility

About N-able:

At N-able, our mission is to protect businesses against evolving cyberthreats with an end-to-end cyber resilience platform to manage, secure, and recover. Our scalable technology infrastructure includes AI-powered capabilities, market-leading third-party integrations, and the flexibility to employ technologies of choice—to transform workflows and deliver critical security outcomes. Our partner-first approach combines our products with experts, training, and peer-led events that empower our customers to be secure, resilient, and successful.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Product Manager**
===================

**Location:** Bengaluru (Peenya)

**Experience:** 3+ years

**Qualification:** B.Optom / Bachelor of Optometry + MBA / B.Pharma + MBA

**Preferred Industry:** Ophthalmology / Medical Devices / Healthcare Diagnostics

**About Remidio**
-----------------

Remidio is a global pioneer in AI-powered ophthalmic diagnostics, transforming access to eye care through innovative imaging devices and intelligent screening solutions. With a presence across 55+ countries and over 16 million screenings, Remidio is advancing the early detection of eye diseases through technology-driven healthcare solutions.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for a commercially driven Product Manager to own product strategy, positioning, lifecycle management and market growth. The role requires a strong combination of clinical understanding, business acumen and marketing expertise to translate customer needs and market insights into product strategies that drive adoption, differentiation and revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* Own product strategy, positioning, lifecycle and portfolio performance.
* Drive product roadmap and prioritisation based on market needs, customer insights and business objectives.
* Translate customer and clinical requirements into product enhancement opportunities.
* Lead new product launches and go-to-market strategies.

**2. Brand & Market Development**

* Develop differentiated product positioning and value propositions.
* Drive brand visibility, market penetration and product adoption.
* Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and growth avenues.
* Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across relevant channels.

**3. Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy**

* Conduct market research, competitor benchmarking and customer analysis.
* Track market trends, competitor offerings, pricing and emerging technologies.
* Convert market intelligence into actionable product and business strategies.

**4. Commercial Growth & Performance**

* Own product-level revenue, market share and adoption objectives.
* Develop annual product and marketing plans aligned with business growth targets.
* Monitor sales performance, product penetration, profitability and market adoption.
* Identify opportunities to accelerate revenue growth and strengthen competitive positioning.
* Manage product marketing budgets, track spends and evaluate campaign ROI.

**5. Sales & Clinical Enablement**

* Partner with Sales teams to drive lead generation, customer engagement and product adoption.
* Support key product demonstrations and strategic customer engagements.
* Develop product training, sales presentations and competitive positioning material.
* Collaborate with Clinical, Engineering, Regulatory and Service teams to ensure effective product execution.
* Data Analytics & Performance Tracking
* Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------

* Optometrist / Pharma with an MBA in Marketing or General Management.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in Product Management, Product Marketing or Brand Management.
* Prior experience in ophthalmology, medical devices or healthcare diagnostics preferred.
* Strong understanding of clinical applications, customer requirements and healthcare markets.
* Ability to translate clinical and technical capabilities into compelling commercial value propositions.
* Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.
text:
**Product Manager**
===================

**Location:** Bengaluru (Peenya)

Remidio is a global pioneer in AI-powered ophthalmic diagnostics, transforming access to eye care through innovative imaging devices and intelligent screening solutions. With a presence across 55+ countries and over 16 million screenings, Remidio is advancing the early detection of eye diseases through technology-driven healthcare solutions.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for a commercially driven Product Manager to own product strategy, positioning, lifecycle management and market growth. The role requires a strong combination of clinical understanding, business acumen and marketing expertise to translate customer needs and market insights into product strategies that drive adoption, differentiation and revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* Own product strategy, positioning, lifecycle and portfolio performance.
* Drive product roadmap and prioritisation based on market needs, customer insights and business objectives.
* Translate customer and clinical requirements into product enhancement opportunities.
* Lead new product launches and go-to-market strategies.

**2. Brand & Market Development**

* Develop differentiated product positioning and value propositions.
* Drive brand visibility, market penetration and product adoption.
* Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and growth avenues.
* Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across relevant channels.

**3. Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy**

* Conduct market research, competitor benchmarking and customer analysis.
* Track market trends, competitor offerings, pricing and emerging technologies.
* Convert market intelligence into actionable product and business strategies.

**4. Commercial Growth & Performance**

* Own product-level revenue, market share and adoption objectives.
* Develop annual product and marketing plans aligned with business growth targets.
* Monitor sales performance, product penetration, profitability and market adoption.
* Identify opportunities to accelerate revenue growth and strengthen competitive positioning.
* Manage product marketing budgets, track spends and evaluate campaign ROI.

* Partner with Sales teams to drive lead generation, customer engagement and product adoption.
* Support key product demonstrations and strategic customer engagements.

**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Position Overview and Objective**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to oversee our network appliance and fleet management infrastructure.

The Senior Product Manager: Network Appliance will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the applications and capabilities we deploy and support on our network appliance platform as well as the infrastructure required to manage our fleet at scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for the applications and capabilities deployed and supported on the platform.

* Drive Datapath capabilities, including IDS, syslog ingestion & pre-parsing, network ML.

* Own on premises features that bridge Arctic Wolf’s cloud to the customer environment via the network appliance platform.

* Define and own licensing, entitlement & SKU structure for product and service sales and pricing.

* Own the customer portal and public APIs, including the customer user experience and interaction with our products and services through both the customer portal and public API usage.

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of software on the fleet – from imaging and configuration, to release management and device upgrades, to fleet-wide monitoring and operations.

* Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for appliance imaging & configuration, including build processes, manufacturer infrastructure deployment, fleet configuration & feature flag management, and zero-touch provisioning.

* Own release management & device upgrades, including fleet rollout practices, containerized application delivery systems (e.g., Docker, ECR) as a reusable platform capability, and the over-the-air (OTA) upgrade experience.

* Own the base OS lifecycle for our Linux RTK OS – major version migration planning, patch cadence, and LTS/EOL policy, and the upgrade infrastructure for the existing fleet.

* Drive fleet management capabilities: dashboards, telemetry aggregation and analysis, and fleet-level configuration and feature-flag operations. Building product features to ensure the scalability and maintainability of our fleet.

* Own vulnerability and CVE patch management, including the field escalation feedback loop from Support & Security teams and engineering.

* Partner with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, to translate strategic initiatives into executable engineering plans for a dedicated feature team.

* Partner with peer product managers to ensure network appliance platform capabilities support the deployment and monitoring of your roadmap initiatives.

* Collaborate with sales on new feature and configuration support.

* Author and maintain detailed functional and technical specifications in product briefs and requirement documents, and support backlog grooming and sprint planning.

Conduct competitive and technical research to inform roadmap decisions and differentiate our appliance services offering.  

  

**Experience & Requirements**

* 10+ years of prior product management experience, ideally in network security, cybersecurity, or appliance/edge software.

* Engineering or technical background, such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Software Engineering.

* Experience with network detection/datapath technologies, API design, or licensing/entitlement systems.

* Experience with Jira, agile planning tools, and product analytics platforms.
Good To Have: Experience with intrusion detection systems, network traffic analysis, or deception technology.  

  

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**
===================================================================================

Position Type

Full Time

Career area

Program, Product & Project Management

Location

4/F, WeWork, Embassy GolfLinks, Karnataka, Karnātaka 560093, India

Job ID

R-97034

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

As Principal Product Manager in Nike's India Technology Center (ITC), you will own the long-term product direction of one of the foundational platforms behind Nike's merchandising. You will sit within Consumer Product & Innovation (CP&I), the technology engine behind Nike's product creation, merchandising, design, and innovation, and report to a Director of Product Management. You will partner closely with global Product, Engineering, Program Management, and Business stakeholders across Nike's matrixed environment. You will also work shoulder-to-shoulder with peers across CP&I and adjacent product organizations to align platform capabilities, evolve foundational tools, and shape the next generation of Nike's merchandising experience across Footwear, Apparel, and Accessories.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a seasoned product leader who leads through deep craft, technical fluency, and broad influence, not through direct authority. You bring a multi-year view of where platforms should go, with the discipline to deliver outcomes one quarter at a time. You are equally comfortable shaping the future architecture with engineering leaders, simplifying complex problems for executives, and partnering with global merchants to turn workflow needs into product.

You have led enterprise-scale platform and internal products before, where the technical and operational depth is real. You have earned the credibility to influence across product organizations you do not directly manage. This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, raise the bar of PMs across CP&I through informal mentorship, and lead through expertise rather than people management.

Key Qualifications :

* 9 to 12+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years on enterprise platforms, data products, or complex internal tools
* Track record of leading platform evolution, modernization, or migration across multiple teams or product organizations
* Technical depth across data architecture, APIs, integrations, and platform engineering trade-offs, with the ability to partner with engineering and architecture as a peer
* Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across business and technology in a global, matrixed environment
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, experience or training; advanced degree preferred Ideally, you also have:

* Experience working on global products in consumer, footwear, apparel, or retail domains
* Exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI applied to enterprise product workflows
* Hands-on experience with change management for platform transitions, from sunsetting legacy tools to training and onboarding global users on the new ones

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

As Principal Product Manager for Merchandising in CP&I, you will own one of CP&I's foundational platforms in the Merchandising space. You will lead its long-term product direction, technical evolution, delivery, and adoption. You will be a hands-on product leader, defining how the platform integrates with the broader Merchandising ecosystem and delivers measurable value to global merchants and the business.

* Define and own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your platform area within Merchandising
* Lead complex platform evolution and modernization efforts, including capability migration, integration, and adoption across product organizations
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape the future platform design, data models, and integration patterns
* Drive disciplined product discovery, delivery, and rollout, including parallel-run, change management, and adoption with global merchant communities
* Align roadmaps and trade-offs with peer product teams across CP&I and adjacent platforms. Represent the Merchandising tooling vision in cross-org and global forums
* Champion product craft within the Merchandising portfolio (frameworks, KPIs, technical PM practices) and informally mentor PMs across CP&I
* Bring emerging technologies like data, AI/ML, and 3D/DPC into the roadmap where they create durable value for the business

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

What You Can Expect

**OUR HIRING GAME PLAN**
------------------------

### **01 Apply**

Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.

### **02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment**

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

### **03 Interview**

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

job_description:
**Product Management**

**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**

**About the Role**

Deloitte is looking for a hands-on product manager to own a product end-to-end within Deloitte Consulting Products. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the day-to-day of a product built for the US market—running discovery, shaping the roadmap, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to ship value clients actually use.

This is a builder's role at its core. You're the strongest product craftsperson on your product: closest to the user, closest to the backlog, and accountable for the outcomes it delivers. You'll work with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders to stay grounded in the market you're building for.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for your product, turning priorities into a clear plan of what to build next

* Make the day-to-day prioritization and trade-off calls, sequencing work by value, effort, and readiness

* Define and track the metrics that show it's working: adoption, engagement, retention, impact

* Know when something isn't working—flag it early and make the case to change course or stop

**Discover & Validate**

* Run discovery to understand your users and the problems worth solving, partnering with US product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders

* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and rapid validation before building at scale

* Use both generative and evaluative research to answer “are we building the right thing?” and “are we building it right?”

**Ship as One Team**

* Take features and products from concept through define, shape, build, and scale

* Own the product backlog: write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and keep it groomed and prioritized

* Work as one team with engineering and UX—sprint planning, reviews, and the daily calls that keep delivery moving

* Own launch, adoption, and iteration; instrument the product and act on what the data shows

* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery to move faster without cutting corners

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients—join demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations, and turn what you hear into the roadmap

* Support go-to-market with product marketing, sales, and account teams: positioning, demos, and enablement

* Stay fluent in the US market realities that shape your product: data privacy, SaaS vs. on-prem

**Work Across the Network**

* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align your product with delivery capacity and real client needs, and be the go-to for questions on your product

* Mentor and lift the product managers and associates around you, modeling strong product craft

**Reporting Relationships**

Reports to a Senior Manager / AVP of Product Management. Works as one team with engineering and UX, partners with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and collaborates with GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 6+ years in product management or product ownership, including owning a product end-to-end

* Track record of shipping products or major features from discovery to launch, with measurable outcomes

* Strong hands-on product craft: backlog, user stories and acceptance criteria, and working day to day with engineering and design in an agile setup

* Fluent in discovery and validation—user research, hypotheses, prototypes—not just delivery

* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

**Preferred**

* Seasoned as a Product Owner in an agile / Scrum environment

* Zero-to-one product or feature launch experience

* Products, professional services, consulting, or enterprise-technology background

* Experience mentoring junior product owners

**Core Competencies**

* Owns outcomes, not just outputs

* Problem-obsessed and customer-centric

* Strong product craft and delivery discipline

* Bias to action—ships, learns, iterates

* Clear communicator with engineering, design, and stakeholders

* Data-driven, with sound judgment

**Why This Role Matters**

Great products are built by people who stay close to the user and close to the craft. This role owns a product built for the US market from the ground in India—discovering what to build, shipping it as one team with engineering and design, and iterating on what clients actually use. It's where strong product managers do their best hands-on work and grow into the leaders who own portfolios next.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

* Seasoned as a Product Owner in an agile / Scrum environment

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners to advance product initiatives and meet business objectives
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and support backlog creation
* Prioritize and re-evaluate requirements throughout the product lifecycle
* Understand the product strategy, roadmap, and future releases
* Break work into user stories and manageable tasks aligned to OKRs
* Create user flows, acceptance criteria, and definitions of done
* Drive backlog grooming and prioritization activities
* Understand team capacity, priorities, and impediments
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and provide constructive feedback
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in technology, computer science, mathematics, economics, statistics, physics, health informatics, business, marketing, or a related field; alternatively, a technical certification, bootcamp, or 2-year technical college qualification
* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to understand and analyze process flow diagrams
* Solid listening, communication, and collaboration skills
* Product-focused mindset

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with product management tools such as Aha!, Rally, and GitHub
* Understanding of personas and customer journeys
* Knowledge of healthcare industry processes and technology
* Familiarity with software development practices and Agile methodologies

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
