author: Hiring Manager
title: Staff Product Manager
job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Job Introduction**

Tekion is expanding its platform into security and compliance products for automotive retail, and we are hiring a senior product professional to own this new product area end to end. This role will build across two connected domains:

* **Compliance / GRC:** Products that help dealerships meet regulatory obligations, including F&I deal compliance, privacy and data governance, and evolving federal and state requirements, directly within the systems they already use.

* **Cybersecurity:** A modular suite of security capabilities delivered as independent products over time, including vulnerability and network scanning, continuous exposure management, endpoint detection and response, email security, credential-exposure monitoring, data-loss prevention, and log analytics / SIEM.

This is both a zero-to-one and scaling mandate. The role will define strategy, roadmap, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market approach, turning validated customer demand into shippable, monetizable products. The role requires close collaboration with US-based stakeholders and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

What You’ll Own

* Product strategy for Tekion’s security and compliance product lines, including the vision, boundaries, and how the two domains reinforce one another.

* Roadmaps for both domains, including sequencing of a modular, SKU-based product portfolio and defining the scope of each release.

* Packaging and pricing models, including subscriptions, consumption-based models, entitlements, and bundling.

* Voice of customer through continuous discovery with dealerships and dealer groups to validate demand before build.

* Cross-functional delivery in partnership with engineering, design, GTM, legal/compliance, security, and platform teams.

Key Responsibilities

Product Development & Strategy

* Own the holistic vision, roadmap, strategy, and launch plan for Automotive Security Cloud across security and compliance workstreams.

* Conduct market and competitive research to identify customer needs, product opportunities, market size, and differentiation.

* Define product positioning, messaging, and business rationale for new security and compliance offerings.

* Build alignment across product, engineering, security, compliance, GTM, legal, and leadership stakeholders.

Requirements & Analysis

* Run continuous customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized, well-specified product requirements.

* Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch requirements; partner with engineering on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.

* Track relevant regulatory requirements, including GLBA Safeguards, FTC rules, CCPA/CPRA, and GDPR, and translate obligations into product capabilities.

* Assess feasibility, risks, dependencies, costs, infrastructure needs, and resource requirements for proposed capabilities.

Go-to-Market & Commercialization

* Define the product/SKU catalog, entitlements, packaging, and pricing models for individual offerings and bundles.

* Build business cases and revenue models for new products, including subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU approaches.

* Recruit and manage design partners, run pilots, and convert validated pilots into referenceable customers and GA launches.

* Represent the product area to executives, sales, customers, and partners; support enablement, launch planning, and market entry.

* Define success metrics such as adoption, attach rate, retention, revenue, and risk reduction, and ensure products are instrumented to measure outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Lead collaboration across technical teams working on areas such as email security, vulnerability management, continuous testing, detection, compliance, and platform integration.

* Maintain alignment with leadership stakeholders on product progress, roadmap decisions, customer feedback, and market dynamics.

* Make independent product decisions with strong ownership, accountability, and clear communication.

* Set and communicate a multi-quarter vision and roadmap with measurable outcomes.

Must-Have Qualifications

* 7+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning security, compliance/GRC, infrastructure, platform, or B2B SaaS products.

* Strong product management fundamentals, including discovery, roadmap definition, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and translating business goals into executable requirements.

* Domain knowledge in at least one of the following: US automotive retail, dealership operations, F&I, DMS/CRM ecosystems, cybersecurity, GRC/privacy tooling, SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability/exposure management, or DLP.

* Demonstrated experience taking a zero-to-one product to market or scaling an existing product line.

* Working knowledge of security architectures, threat models, security controls, and relevant compliance frameworks.

* Experience with subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU packaging and pricing for B2B SaaS products.

* Proven ability to work autonomously, make decisions independently, and drive products from concept through launch.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into clear product decisions.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.

* Comfortable working with US-based teams and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

Good-to-Have Qualifications

* Experience selling into or building products for regulated SMB or mid-market verticals.

* Familiarity with building on a platform or system of record such as DMS, CRM, or ERP.

* Experience productizing an internal capability into a customer-facing offering.

* Familiarity with ISO standards, SOC 2, dealership compliance, privacy regulations, and broader security governance needs.

* Hands-on exposure to security product categories such as vulnerability scanners, continuous penetration testing platforms, email security, threat detection, endpoint security, cloud security, or SIEM/log analytics.

* Experience evaluating build, buy, or partner decisions based on technical feasibility, cost, time-to-market, integration effort, vendor maturity, and long-term differentiation.

* Track record launching greenfield products, entering new markets, or operating in early-stage or 0-to-1 environments.

* Experience with pricing strategy, cost analysis, revenue modeling, or budget planning for security or compliance products.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**[ WHO WE ARE]**

Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. Founded in 2007, KRAFTON consists of PUBG STUDIOS, Bluehole Studio, RisingWings, Striking Distance Studios, Dreamotion, Unknown Worlds, 5minlab, Neon Giant, KRAFTON Montréal Studio and ReLU Games, each trying to innovate the enjoyment of games through continuously embracing challenges and new technologies, expanding our platforms and services to win the hearts of more fans.

KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community.

The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties that include highly popular titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby, New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country.

With a focus on India, KRAFTON is dedicated to nurturing the gaming and start-up ecosystem. In line with this commitment, KRAFTON initiated the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) in October 2023. KIGI aims to support 6-10 teams annually with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally, KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years and has committed an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years.

**Responsibilities**

* Act as Product Manager, define and manage the **roadmap** for India-facing features, collaboration events, and engagement loops.
* Write clear **PRDs**, set success metrics, and make data-driven product decisions.
* Act as **feature producer**: plan sprints, track progress, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery.
* Lead **live-ops execution**, including events, content updates, reward systems, and real-time issue handling.
* Drive **user growth, onboarding, retention**, and monetization improvements for the Indian market.
* Collaborate with central teams, external partners, and marketing on feature launches and IP tie-ups.
* Analyze player data and market trends to optimize features and event performance.

**Qualification**

* 5 years in mobile gaming product management or production.
* Strong understanding of F2P systems, live-ops, and mobile game KPIs.
* Experience working cross-functionally with design, engineering, QA, and data.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.
* Available for International travel and work with cross-continent teams
* Passion for shooter games & Indian mobile gaming trends.

What you get in return

* Learn Best-in-class global product practices, and scope for fast growth
* Ability to learn from teams across the globe
* Open and transparent work culture with ownership
* Work on India’s biggest game of the decade.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Understands Analytics, Product Development, Producer Scrums very well, (AI part will be taught on the job)
* Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.
* Available for International travel and work with cross-continent teams
* Passion for shooter games & Indian mobile gaming trends.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Principal Product Manager IT/OT D-Hub
job_description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  

**Principal Product Manager IT/OT D-Hub**

**POSITION PURPOSE:**

The Principal Product Manager is responsible for the overall product vision, strategy and roadmap across a specific Platform or domain and works on the hardest problems within the Platform. They make specific contributions to Product and Platform delivery by working directly with Product Squads within the Platform to ensure each product is oriented toward business outcomes that improve company performance. The Principal Product Manager partners directly with the Platform Lead and their teams to deliver. The Principal Product Manager is an expert communicator that represents the Platform by presenting to senior leaders across Bayer and externally to accelerate digital transformation and build Bayer’s reputation as a digital leading company.

Principal Product Managers apply the product management discipline to some of the hardest problems within the Platform. They ensure that products are fulfilling their primary purpose to enable users to perform tasks that create value for the company by:

* Setting strategic vision for the product to ensure the customer and their needs are at the center; and ensuring team priorities are supporting business outcomes for customer, product, technical and enabling teams. This requires continual alignment of the product strategy and objectives with customer, product, technical, and enabling teams

* Managing the product backlog, which prioritizes the work of the assigned squads, to achieve the vision and aligned strategy.

To successfully manage these areas of responsibility, Principal Product Managers must have a deep understanding of the product domain, related technology, and architecture.

  

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Product Management**

The product manager is accountable for the overall success of a product throughout its lifecycle, from conception to decommissioning. They identify domain needs, develop, and validate product concepts, and build a business case. They oversee the product's build and launch, including any sourced services; as well as ensure product availability, stability, and compliance needs are met. Product managers collaborate with various teams, including product development, marketing, finance, legal, manufacturing, operations, and sales, as needed, to ensure cohesive progress and success.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (AI Agents) - Bengaluru
job_description:
We are looking for a technically strong Product Manager with hands-on experience building AI-powered products and agents. You will own product strategy, customer discovery and roadmap for enterprise AI applications, turning complex workflows into scalable, reusable product capabilities.

**Company Details**

Live2.ai is building an AI-native Social Content Intelligence Operating System for global consumer brands.

Its platform uses AI agents to monitor conversations, audit campaigns, analyse consumer behaviour, track influencers and turn social content into commerce. The product combines LLM orchestration, reasoning agents, multimodal AI and enterprise workflow automation.

Website: https://live2.ai/

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise platforms or AI products.
* Mandatory hands-on product management experience with AI/LLM-powered applications or AI agents.
* Practical understanding of LLMs, prompting, RAG, tool calling, agent workflows and AI evaluation.
* Strong technical understanding of APIs, integrations, distributed systems and data architecture.
* Experience translating complex customer problems into product requirements and shipping products with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to distinguish reusable product capabilities from customer-specific customisations.
* Comfortable working directly with enterprise customers and technical teams.
* Willingness to work from the Bengaluru office.

**Responsibilities**

* Own product vision, strategy, roadmap and prioritisation for enterprise AI products and agent platforms.
* Drive customer discovery across enterprise customers and identify recurring workflow problems.
* Convert customer requirements into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
* Define product experiences for building, configuring, testing, evaluating and improving AI agents.
* Work with AI and Engineering teams on tool calling, retrieval, model selection, guardrails and failure handling.
* Define success metrics for AI agents, including task completion, accuracy, reliability, latency and cost.
* Drive enterprise integrations, APIs, permissions, governance and platform readiness.
* Create PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Use prototypes and lightweight proofs of concept to validate product assumptions.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, AI, Sales, Solutions and Customer Success teams.
* Track product adoption, customer value, retention and platform scalability.

**Job Details**

Bengaluru, Work from Office

**Interview Process**

* Introductory Discussion
* Product & Technical Deep Dive
* Practical Product Exercise
* Founder Discussion

**Important Note**

ClanX is a recruitment partner, helping Live2.ai hire a Product Manager for its Enterprise AI Agents team.

job_description:
For Singapore Applicants:  
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* Experience with mobile app security, app store ecosystems, or content moderation platforms.
* Technical familiarity with LLM security evaluation, AI threat models (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), or static/dynamic code analysis tools.
* Strong data-driven mindset with experience defining and optimizing multi-objective platform metrics (safety vs. speed vs. operational cost).

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The App and Ecosystem Trust (AET) team ensures safe, secure, and trustworthy experiences across our global app ecosystem. Mokka is the core review engine that processes every app submission, update, and runtime signal to protect billions of users from security vulnerabilities, policy violations, and malicious behavior.  
  
As the Product Manager for Mokka, you will take the lead on driving the overall strategy and tactical execution of our next-generation review infrastructure. Your core mission is to bridge advanced ML-driven detection capabilities with developer velocity, ensuring our entire ecosystem remains secure without unnecessary friction.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the multi-year product roadmap for Mokka, the app safety review platform, to scale under submission volume increases driven by AI-assisted code generation (vibe coding).
* Architect automated static, dynamic, and LLM-assisted review pipelines that intercept modern security threats before apps reach production. Design robust defenses against emerging AI vulnerabilities, including malicious model weights, indirect prompt injection vectors, agentic permission escalation, and generative privacy leaks.
* Balance friction-free onboarding for legitimate developers with rigorous verification checks for high-risk or automated app factories.
* Partner with Operations and Policy teams to design intelligent human-in-the-loop review interfaces, leveraging generative AI assistants to speed up analyst workflows and reduce manual cognitive load.
* Partner closely with ML Research, Security Engineering, Policy Operations, and Developer Relations across global sites (US, Bangalore, London, Singapore) and drive alignment across vertical AET teams (e.g. Content, Malware)

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Senior Product Manager Disruption Management
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

**Role Overview**

  

This role will own the product vision for simplifying and automating how schedule changes are identified, evaluated, communicated, and resolved, helping airlines reduce manual servicing while delivering a better traveller experience.

The Senior Product Manager will work across airline operations, reservations, servicing, reaccommodation, notifications, digital channels, and partner ecosystems to build scalable capabilities that support airlines with different business models, workflows, and levels of automation.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

**Product Strategy & Ownership**

  

Define how the product evolves from manual and rules-based servicing towards increasingly **automated, intelligent, and self-service schedule change management** .

* Translate airline operational challenges and traveller needs into clear product requirements, features, and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritise investments based on customer value, operational impact, strategic alignment, and technical feasibility.

**Schedule Change & Airline Servicing Expertise**

* Develop solutions covering the end-to-end schedule change lifecycle, including: Detection and classification of itinerary changes.Assessment of impacted passengers and itineraries.Airline policies and reaccommodation rules.Identification and presentation of alternative flights.Automated and agent-assisted reaccommodation.Traveller notification and acceptance.Digital self-service.Ticketing and servicing considerations.Handling of ancillary products and associated services.Interline and partner-airline scenarios.Exceptions requiring manual intervention.
* Ensure solutions can support different airline policies, thresholds, workflows, and customer servicing strategies.
* Partner with adjacent product areas such as **DCS, reservations, disruption management/IROPs, retailing, customer servicing, notifications, and airport solutions** .

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Engage directly with airline customers to understand current workflows, pain points, requirements, and desired business outcomes.
* Serve as a product subject-matter expert in customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and roadmap reviews.
* Monitor airline industry trends and evolving expectations around automated servicing and traveller self-service.
* Balance individual airline requirements with the development of scalable product capabilities.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, operations, and other product teams to translate strategy into executable product increments.
* Develop clear epics, requirements, acceptance criteria, and business priorities.
* Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
* Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
* Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

**Commercial & Business Outcomes**

* Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
* Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
* Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, preferably within **airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations** .
* Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
* Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
* Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
* Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
* Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
* Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
* Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including **Offers and Orders** , would be beneficial.
* Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
* Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
* Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

### **What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.

They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.

Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.

### **Ideal Candidate**

This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They are comfortable moving from a detailed conversation about servicing rules or reaccommodation logic to an executive discussion about automation, customer experience, revenue protection, and operating cost.

They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

* Balance individual airline requirements with the development of scalable product capabilities.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, operations, and other product teams to translate strategy into executable product increments.
* Develop clear epics, requirements, acceptance criteria, and business priorities.
* Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
* Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
* Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

**Commercial & Business Outcomes**

* Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
* Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
* Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, preferably within **airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations** .
* Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
* Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
* Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
* Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
* Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
* Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
* Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including **Offers and Orders** , would be beneficial.
* Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
* Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
* Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

### **What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.

They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.

Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.

### **Ideal Candidate**

This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They are comfortable moving from a detailed conversation about servicing rules or reaccommodation logic to an executive discussion about automation, customer experience, revenue protection, and operating cost.

They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
This is a growth-stage product operator role, not a 0-to-1 role. Webnyay has a mature product, established enterprise customers, live deployments, and meaningful transaction volumes across dispute resolution and grievance redressal.

Our platform powers complex workflows across arbitration, mediation, online dispute resolution, and BFSI grievance management. The product is live, the customers are real, and the operational challenges are substantial.

Your job is to grow it — through better, faster, and more scalable versions of what works, while building new capabilities that expand what our customers can do with Webnyay.

You should be comfortable working with complex workflows, demanding enterprise customers, and engineering teams. You should be equally comfortable understanding a legal or operational problem, translating it into a product requirement, and driving it all the way to deployment.

You'll Own

* **Product roadmap:** Owning and driving the roadmap across Webnyay's ODR, arbitration, mediation, BFSI dispute resolution, and grievance redressal products.
* **New feature development:** Identifying high-leverage opportunities from customer feedback, operational bottlenecks, and market requirements. Scoping and shipping capabilities that improve product value and expand our addressable market.
* **Backlog prioritisation:** Turning hundreds of customer requests, change requests, bug reports, and internal ideas into a coherent, prioritised shipping plan. Knowing what to build, what to defer, and what to push back on.
* **Enterprise workflow optimisation:** Understanding end-to-end dispute resolution workflows — from case initiation, notice generation and service, document management, hearings and arbitrator workflows to award generation, closure, billing, and reporting — and continuously improving them.
* **Customer-facing product management:** Working directly with customers, understanding their requirements, managing expectations, communicating feature releases, and handling difficult conversations around timelines, scope, and prioritisation.
* **Product documentation:** Writing clear PRDs, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and release notes that engineering and implementation teams can execute against.
* **Cross-functional execution:** Working closely with engineering leads, design, legal operations, implementation, business development, and customer success to take features from requirement to production.
* **Product analytics:** Using product usage, operational metrics, customer feedback, and workflow data to identify friction, measure adoption, and make informed product decisions.
* **Competitive positioning:** Tracking the legal-tech, ODR, BFSI technology, and enterprise SaaS landscape to identify product gaps, emerging capabilities, and opportunities to differentiate Webnyay.

You'll work directly with the leadership team and have significant ownership over product decisions and execution.

How We Work: AI-Native by Default

This is important enough to call out clearly: **we expect our Product Managers to use AI across the entire product lifecycle.** AI is not a separate workstream or an occasional productivity tool. It should be embedded in how you research, think, design, document, build, and ship.

That Means

* **Discovery:** Synthesising customer interviews, analysing support tickets and change requests at scale, researching legal and regulatory requirements, and gathering competitive intelligence using AI tools.

* **Automate:** Identifying repetitive workflows across product, operations, and customer delivery that can be simplified or automated using AI agents and integrations.

job_description:
**Company Description**

**About the Company -**

(https://www.mastersindia.co/)

Masters India IT Solutions is a growing **B2B SaaS Product Company**, serving over 1500+ large enterprises. We are proud to be **Great Place To Work – Certified™**, reflecting our commitment to building a positive, growth-oriented workplace culture.

Masters India is one of the biggest GST Suvidha Providers (GSP) appointed by the Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) of the Government of India since 2017. Our mission is to build intuitive software solutions that simplify complex challenges faced by businesses across industries. We are fulfilling this mission by offering tax and financial automation products to enterprises.

Masters India IT Solutions is part of the 45-year-old Masters India Group, which has a diversified presence across Manufacturing, Healthcare, Hospitality, and IT, with an aggregate turnover of INR 1000+ Crores.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (CA) with hands-on experience in Product Management to build the strategy, roadmap, discovery and execution of our GST and e-invoicing platform.**

**This role sits at the intersection of tax regulations, finance operations and technology. You will be responsible for translating evolving statutory requirements and real-world taxpayer challenges into scalable, intuitive and technology-led SaaS products.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory & Product Planning**

* **Bring GST and Compliance expertise to product development, so that features are accurate, follow the law and are ready for regulatory changes on time.**

**Track GST Council decisions, CBIC/GSTN notifications and IRP/NIC changes, and turn them into product initiatives delivered ahead of compliance deadlines.**

* **Help prioritise initiatives based on customer impact, business value, regulatory urgency and technical feasibility.**
* **Spot market gaps and customer needs across enterprises, ERP ecosystems, GSPs/ASPs, tax practitioners and CA firms.**

**Domain Ownership**

* **Own the functional understanding of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2A/2B, GSTR-9/9C, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills.**
* **Translate law, rules and notifications into clear requirements, business rules, validations and user workflows.**
* **Define reconciliation logic and exception handling that improve accuracy, cut manual effort and reduce compliance risk.**

**Discovery & Execution**

* **Talk to customers, finance teams and CAs to understand workflows and pain points; validate ideas through prototypes and feedback.**
* **Identify AI and automation opportunities such as invoice data extraction, anomaly detection and reconciliation assistance.**
* **Write PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios; work with engineering on APIs, ERP integrations and system workflows.**
* **Lead UAT and functional validation to ensure regulatory accuracy and quality before release.**

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Must-Have**

* **Educational Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) with a demonstrated transition into Product Management.**
* **Domain Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Indian indirect tax, particularly GST law and processes, GST returns, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Exposure to GSP/ASP ecosystems, GSTN, IRP and NIC APIs**
* **Product experience: Hands-on experience across the product lifecycle (discovery, requirements, launch, iteration), ideally in compliance, tax-tech or fintech SaaS.**
* **Documentation: Clear PRDs, user stories, functional specs and test scenarios.**
* **Technical understanding: Working knowledge of APIs, integrations and ERP/accounting platforms; comfortable working with engineers.**
* **Data & communication: Uses data and customer insights to make decisions; communicates well across engineering, business, customer success and leadership.**
* **Prior experience in tax advisory, statutory audit, finance operations or enterprise compliance before transitioning into Product Management**

**Good to Have**

* **Experience building AI-enabled products or features, with an understanding of AI capabilities and their application in compliance and finance workflows.**
* **Experience working with enterprise customers and ERP ecosystems such as SAP, Oracle and Tally.**
* **Understanding of data security, privacy, regulatory compliance and enterprise SaaS requirements.**

 **Qualifications**

**Chartered Accountant (CA) with a passion for Product Management**

 **Additional Information**

**Job Location:** Procapitus Business Park, D Block, Sector 63, Noida  
**Type:** Permanent, Onsite (5 Days)

**Notice Period:** Immediate -30 days  
  
**Industry:** IT Product

title: Product Manager, Children
job_description:
Simon & Schuster is a global leader in general interest publishing, dedicated to providing the best in fiction and nonfiction for readers of all ages, and in all printed, digital, and audio formats. Its distinguished roster of authors includes many of the world’s most popular and widely recognized writers, and winners of the most prestigious literary honors and awards. It is home to numerous well-known imprints and divisions such as Simon & Schuster, Scribner, Atria Books, Gallery Books, Pocket Books, Adams Media, Simon & Schuster Children’s Publishing and Simon & Schuster Audio and international companies in Australia, Canada, India, and the United Kingdom, and proudly brings the works of its authors to readers in more than 200 countries and territories. For more information visit our website at www.simonandschuster.com.
  
  
The Job Profile
  
We have an exciting vacancy for a Product Manager, Childrens, to join our energetic Product India team.
  
Reporting to the Product & Procurement Director, the Product Manager, Childrens will be responsible for building and developing the children’s books portfolio for the India market. Children’s books represent an important growth opportunity across schools, parents, institutions, retail, online platforms and distribution channels.
  
The Job Role
  
The Product Manager will be responsible for developing and growing the children’s books portfolio for the Indian market by identifying and evaluating relevant titles from S&S UK, S&S US and client publishers. This will include managing the title pipeline, supporting list planning, pricing and positioning, identifying market opportunities, and providing product recommendations to distribution clients. Working closely with sales, marketing and distribution teams, the Product Manager will monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer demand, drive the visibility and performance of the children’s list, and develop a commercially attractive portfolio to support the company’s distribution growth strategy.
  
The Candidate Profile
  
The Product Manager will have a strong understanding of the children’s books market, excellent commercial, analytical and product selection skills, and the ability to identify new titles and market opportunities.
  
They will have experience in product management, publishing, editorial, sales, category management or a related field, ideally within the children’s books, education, retail or e-commerce sectors. Experience in book selection, list planning and working with publishers, distributors or international publishing organisations would be an advantage. Strong communication and relationship-building skills, attention to detail, proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to manage multiple priorities are essential.
  
**Salary:** Competitive & Benefits
  
Please apply by attaching your CV and cover letter.
  
  
Simon & Schuster India is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). At Simon & Schuster India, the spirit of inclusion feeds into everything that we do. From employee benefits/programs and social impact outreach initiatives, we believe that opportunity, access, resources, and rewards should be available to and for the benefit of all. Simon & Schuster India is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, and Veteran status.
  
  
Candidates hired for this or any other posted Simon & Schuster India role will be employees of Simon & Schuster Publishers India Private Limited, subject to all policies, including the Workplace Privacy Notice, and eligible solely for the benefits plans thereof.

**Experience: 4 to 8 Years**  
**Qualification: Any Graduate**

* Negotiator and Influencer.

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: AI Product Manager
job_description:
**Open Position: AI Product Manager**  
**Location: Malad (West), Mumbai**  
**Experience: 4+ years**  
**Qualification: Bachelor’s degree**   
**Only candidates based in Mumbai Suburban locations (Dahisar to Dadar) should apply for the Position.**

**You can also contact on: 9372974661 / 8928772622 / 7021155918**  
**We are working 6 days, i.e., from Monday to Saturday.**

**Role Summary**

Drive the roadmap and execution of an AI-powered LMS while managing the product development team. Focus on building scalable, user-friendly solutions that improve adoption and learning outcomes across industries.

**Job Description**

* Define and execute product roadmap for AI-driven LMS/LXP
* Manage and align the product development team for timely delivery
* Build AI-powered features such as personalized learning, recommendations, and chatbot interfaces
* Own end-to-end product lifecycle from requirements to release
* Work closely with enterprise clients to gather requirements and tailor solutions
* Drive product customization to suit different industries and use cases
* Prepare effort estimates and scope for new modules, enhancements, and customizations
* Improve user adoption, engagement, and overall experience
* Drive integrations with HRMS, content platforms, and collaboration tools
* Track product performance using data and analytics

**Requirements**

* 4+ years in Product Management (SaaS preferred)
* Experience in LMS, LXP, or HR Tech is a plus
* Strong understanding of AI/ML use cases in products
* Exposure to authoring tools and content creation workflows
* Experience in managing product or cross-functional development teams
* Experience in effort estimation, scoping, and requirement analysis
* Strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills

**Good to Have**

* Experience with enterprise clients across industries
* Exposure to chatbot or conversational AI products
* Understanding of learning ecosystems and competency frameworks

**Key KPIs for This Role**

* Release Efficiency: % of features delivered on time vs planned roadmap
* Time to Market: Average time taken from feature finalization to market launch
* Wireframing Effectiveness: Time taken to convert requirements into approved wireframes
* AI Feature Impact: Usage and effectiveness of AI-driven features
* Customization Turnaround: Time taken to scope and deliver client-specific enhancements
* User Engagement: Improvement in completion rates, repeat usage, and session frequency
* Customer Feedback: Reduction in escalations and improvement in satisfaction scores
* Integration Success: Number and stability of integrations delivered
* Team Productivity: Sprint velocity, backlog closure rate, and development cycle time

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

====================================================

Date: Nov 6, 2026

Location: Sun House - Corporate Office

Company: Sun Pharma Laboratories Ltd

**Job Title:**

Group Product Manager (Rural Chronic)

**Business Unit:**

Alternate Channels

  

**Location:**

Sun House, Mumbai

  
  
  

At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you **“Create your own sunshine”**— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?

  

As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”

  

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Development, collaboration, implementation, & accountability for strategic and operational plans which optimize profitability, market share, and revenue growth for a brand portfolio in the short and long term. Applicant to lead various assignments to help the BU meet overall BU business goals
* Development of marketing and promotional plans for products to support the end customers (Doctors) need
* Monitor business performance and support the portfolio with the help of regular tracking
* Market intelligence through primary research and customer connect of 2 weeks every month
* Writing and executing strategic business and marketing plans in collaboration with important prescribers, opinion leaders, round tables, and other advisory groups
* Joint financial responsibility for budgets (advertising and promotion, conferences and symposia, sales brochures and other product documentation, website content, literature), as well as analysis of budget income and costs;
* Initiating and coordinating marketing activities and projects
* Presentation to staff and training field staff for the same
* Translating the corporate brand strategy in close collaboration with headquarters, together with logos and visuals, working with corporate product budgets (approval for expenditure on projects, local communication strategies), and providing input into corporate product strategy;
* Discussion partner for first, second, and third-line professionals such as general practitioners, medical specialists, pharmacists, and other medical professionals, and for other DMU members (decision-making units) such as local bodies/gram panchayats
* Organizing advisory councils, acting as a discussion leader or chairman, or giving product presentations.
* Collaboration with internal & external media to ensure the proper execution of strategies
* Rural data analysis

  

**Job Requirements**

  

**Educational Qualification**

B. Pharm / M. Pharm & MBA

  

**Experience**

8 years+ experience in Pharma Marketing

  

* Therapy exposure: candidate with experience in CVD therapy will be preferred
* Demonstrable success in marketing or sales
* Strategic insight
* Effective networking skills and planning ability
* Creativity and persuasiveness
* Analytical and conceptual strength
* Strong and inspiring personality
* Self-starting and entrepreneurial
  

**Your Success Matters to Us**

  

At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. *Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**Key Responsibilities**  
As the Product Manager for P&DI for energy sector data products (specifically, areas like solar), you will own the product lifecycle of our offerings and also run program management across the product portfolio. Your responsibilities will be to:

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for relevant products, from opportunity discovery and business case through launch, scale-up and lifecycle management.
* Translate utility, C&I and consumer needs into clear problem statements, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and prioritise the backlog against business value, effort and risk.
* Work closely with Engineering, Data Science, IoT/hardware, Design and Operations teams to deliver products on time and with high quality, running sprint planning, reviews and release readiness.
* Define pricing, packaging and go-to-market plans for new energy products in partnership with Sales, Marketing and Partnerships, and support pilots and early customer deployments.
* Define product KPIs and success metrics (adoption, energy savings, revenue, reliability, customer satisfaction), and use data and customer feedback to iterate on the product.
* Run program management across all P&DI products for energy: maintain an integrated plan of milestones, dependencies, risks and resourcing, and drive cross-functional alignment on timelines and scope.
* Set up and run a consistent program governance rhythm, including status reporting, risk and issue escalation, change control and steering reviews with senior leadership.
* Track budgets, vendor and partner deliverables, and compliance with regulatory, security, data privacy and enterprise standards across programs.
* Conduct market, competitor and regulatory research in the energy sector (solar, storage, EV charging, smart metering, demand response, energy analytics) to shape product direction.
* Build reusable product and program playbooks, templates and tools that improve predictability and speed across teams.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, customers and partners, and act as a thought partner who challenges assumptions and adapts priorities as needs change.

Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field from a reputed university. An MBA or advanced degree will be an added advantage.
* 4–6 years of experience in product management, with at least 1–2 years running multi-team programs or projects, preferably in energy, utilities, IoT, cleantech or B2B technology.
* Proven track record of taking a product from concept to launch and scale, including writing PRDs, managing backlogs and working in agile teams.
* Strong program management skills: planning, dependency and risk management, stakeholder governance and delivery tracking across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Good understanding of the energy value chain and technologies such as solar, battery storage, EV charging, smart meters, and energy management or analytics platforms.
* Working knowledge of IoT and data-driven products, including APIs, platform architecture, dashboards and analytics, with the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams.
* Ability to build business cases, pricing models and financial plans, and to define and track product metrics using data (SQL, BI tools or similar).
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or equivalent, and with product and prototyping tools such as Figma.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

* Working knowledge of IoT and data-driven products, including APIs, platform architecture, dashboards and analytics, with the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams.
* Ability to build business cases, pricing models and financial plans, and to define and track product metrics using data (SQL, BI tools or similar).
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or equivalent, and with product and prototyping tools such as Figma.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

author: Hiring Manager
role: Senior Product Owner - Service and Supervision (IVR)
role_title: Senior Product Owner - Service and Supervision (IVR)
title: Senior Product Owner - Service and Supervision (IVR)
job_description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**

The Omni IVR Product Owner will be responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering enhancements that improve the customer voice experience through natural language understanding, intelligent call routing, and contact center automation. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, operations, and vendor partners to translate customer and advisor needs into actionable product requirements, optimize call flows, reduce misroutes, improve containment, and ensure IVR capabilities align with service strategy, operational readiness, and measurable business outcomes.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Partner closely with the Product Manager to translate the Omni IVR roadmap into prioritized features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint-ready backlog items that support natural language, call routing, and service experience objectives.
* Own day-to-day Product Owner responsibilities, including backlog refinement, story prioritization, dependency management, sprint planning support, requirement clarification, and coordination with delivery teams to ensure roadmap commitments are executed successfully.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, operations, technology, UX, analytics, and vendor partners to gather requirements, validate call flow changes, support testing, resolve defects, and drive continuous improvement across IVR routing, containment, and caller experience.

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 7–8 years of experience working with voice systems, IVR platforms, contact center technologies, or related customer service technology solutions.
* Experience serving as a Product Owner or in a similar product delivery role, including backlog management, user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, and sprint execution support.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, demos, testing support, and production readiness activities.
* Ability to translate business needs, caller experience goals, and operational requirements into clear features, user stories, call flow changes, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across Product Management, technology, operations, analytics, and vendor teams.

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* Advanced collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product Management, technology, operations, analytics, UX, vendors, and business stakeholders to drive shared outcomes.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, including the ability to lead requirement discussions, clarify complex needs, manage competing priorities, and build alignment across diverse teams.
* Value-driven product ownership mindset, with the ability to balance client experience, operational efficiency, technical feasibility, roadmap priorities, and delivery commitments while acting with integrity and helping the team win together.

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Experience with natural language understanding, conversational IVR, speech recognition, text-to-speech, intent design, call routing logic, or voice bot capabilities.
* Familiarity with contact center platforms, telephony technologies, CRM integrations, routing strategies, call flow design, or service center operations.
* Experience using data, reporting, or performance metrics such as containment, misroutes, transfer rates, call volume, average handle time, and customer experience trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Proficiency with Agile delivery tools and documentation practices, such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio, or similar tools used for backlog management, process flows, and requirement traceability.

job_description:
#### **About the company**

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.  
  
We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.  
  
A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.  
  
At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.  
  
Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?  
  
Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.  
  
**Our values**

* **Be a wolf, not a sheep:** we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
* **Knowledge equals power:** we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
* **Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy:** we want work to be something you look forward to.
* **Quality results in quantity:** we care about excellence and attention to detail.
* **TEAM, Together everyone achieves more:** collaboration is how we get our best results.

Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

#### **About the role**

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.
* Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.
* Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.
* Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.
* Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.
* Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

#### **What we are looking for**

**Competences**

* **Hosting & Security Products Knowledge:** Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.
* **Supplier & Vendor Management:** Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.
* **Commercial & P&L Acumen:** Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.
* **Product Strategy & Roadmapping:** Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.
* **Project & Programme Management:** Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
* **Data & Funnel Analytics:** Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
* **AI Proficiency:** Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

**How we work at Openprovider**

* **Self-management:** you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
* **Learning Agility and AI Literacy:** you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
* **Adaptive Innovation Mindset:** you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
* **Quality Orientation:** you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
* **Customer Focus:** you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

#### **What we offer**

* 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
* Paid time off and sick leave;
* International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
* Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
* Quarterly review and annual salary review;
* Flexible working hours;
* We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
* Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

#### **About us**

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.
