title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a **technically strong Senior Product Manager with hands-on experience building and launching AI-powered B2B enterprise products**.

You will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for intelligent products and platform capabilities that solve complex customer and operational problems. Working closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Design, and Data teams, you will take capabilities from discovery and prototyping through production deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.

This role requires strong technical judgment, an understanding of enterprise workflows, and demonstrated AI product development experience—not just familiarity with AI tools.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning enterprise customer needs with business priorities.
* Lead customer discovery to identify high-value problems and determine where AI, deterministic workflows, or a combination of both provides the best solution.
* Translate complex requirements into clear PRDs, user journeys, feature specifications, user stories, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, technical feasibility, dependencies, risk, and delivery effort.
* Own the product lifecycle from concept and validation through launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.

### **AI Product Development**

* Lead the development of AI-powered experiences, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows.
* Partner with AI/ML and Engineering teams on model selection, grounding, tool integrations, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Define agent behaviors, intent routing, skill specifications, policy configurations, permissions, and fallback mechanisms.
* Establish evaluation frameworks and curated golden datasets to assess accuracy, task completion, reliability, safety, and edge-case handling.
* Define release criteria and production monitoring, balancing output quality, latency, inference cost, and user experience.
* Use customer feedback, evaluation results, and production insights to continuously improve AI capabilities.

### **Technical Product Leadership**

* Collaborate with Engineering on scalable services, Java-based microservices, Kafka event pipelines, and agentic platform integrations.
* Review system designs, API specifications, data models, and integration flows to clarify requirements and evaluate trade-offs.
* Define API requirements, data contracts, authentication and authorization needs, and failure-handling expectations.
* Partner with platform and data teams on schemas, instrumentation, observability, and integration dependencies.
* Ensure enterprise requirements—including security, privacy, access controls, reliability, scalability, and auditability—are incorporated into product decisions.
* Participate in technical troubleshooting and root-cause discussions with engineering teams.

### **Delivery, Measurement & Adoption**

* Own backlog prioritization and partner with engineering Scrum teams to deliver outcome-focused releases.
* Define and track KPIs across adoption, task success, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, AI quality, and cost.
* Validate solutions through prototypes, experiments, pilot programs, and customer feedback.
* Drive launch readiness, stakeholder communication, user enablement, and change management.
* Communicate roadmap decisions, dependencies, risks, and technical trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* **5+ years of Product Management experience**, with ownership of technically complex products.
* **B2B enterprise product management experience is a must**, including experience addressing complex workflows, integrations, and the needs of multiple stakeholders.
* **Proven experience building and shipping AI/ML-powered products into production**, with direct ownership of discovery, requirements, evaluation, launch, and measurable outcomes.
* Strong practical understanding of LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, tool calling, and AI limitations and failure modes.
* Experience defining AI evaluation criteria, test scenarios, quality benchmarks, and production feedback loops.
* Strong technical fluency across distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, APIs, and data platforms.
* Hands-on experience working with RESTful APIs, webhooks, authentication mechanisms, and enterprise integrations.
* Ability to read and discuss architecture diagrams, API documentation, data models, and technical specifications with engineering teams.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with experience defining KPIs and using data to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* **Experience building campaign management or CRM products.**
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent orchestration, and reusable AI tools or skills.
* Experience authoring PRD-as-Code artifacts, including intent definitions, skill specifications, and policy configurations.
* Familiarity with Java-based services, Kafka, cloud infrastructure, and AI observability tools.
* Experience with AI security, privacy, prompt-injection risks, and responsible AI practices.
* Ability to use SQL, API testing tools, and workflow automation tools to validate assumptions and investigate issues.
* Prior experience in automotive retail, dealer technology, or enterprise operational workflows.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Technical Product Manager (TPM) for CareSelect Imaging is responsible for translating product strategy, customer needs, and business priorities into clear, executable technical work and driving that work through successful delivery.

This role serves as a critical connection point between Product Management and Engineering, partnering closely with development teams in India and the U.S., as well as Architecture, QA, Operations, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders. The Senior TPM must be able to understand the intended business and customer outcome, translate that need into manageable technical capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and remain actively engaged through planning, development, testing, release, and post-release validation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with disciplined product execution. This individual does not need to be the solution architect or engineering lead, but must be technically fluent enough to understand system interactions, integrations, APIs, data flows, dependencies, and technical constraints; ask the right questions; challenge assumptions; and facilitate alignment between business and technical teams.

A key measure of success in this role is the ability to turn complex or sometimes ambiguous business needs into well-understood, appropriately scoped work that engineering teams can execute predictably.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Translate strategy into executable work: Partner with Product Management to translate business, customer, and product needs into well-defined capabilities, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized technical work
* Own backlog readiness and work decomposition: Break complex initiatives into manageable increments, maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog, and ensure work is sufficiently defined and understood before entering development
* Partner closely with Engineering: Work day-to-day with onshore and offshore Engineering, Architecture, and QA teams to clarify requirements, evaluate technical approaches, understand APIs, integrations, data flows, and dependencies, and resolve questions throughout development
* Drive delivery across teams: Support sprint and PI planning, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and proactively manage scope, risks, blockers, and decisions from initial definition through development and delivery
* Ensure quality and release readiness: Partner with Engineering and QA on testing, acceptance criteria, UAT, release readiness, and deployment activities, ensuring product changes meet intended business and customer outcomes
* Communicate and continuously improve: Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and release impacts while identifying opportunities to improve requirements quality, delivery predictability, and collaboration across distributed teams
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
* 3+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, product management, business systems analysis, or technology delivery
* Experience working directly with engineering leadership, architects, and distributed development teams
* Experience supporting PI planning, dependency management, and scaled Agile delivery
* Experience managing and prioritizing backlogs in an Agile product-development environment
* Experience partnering directly with engineering teams to clarify requirements and drive work through planning and delivery
* Experience with Agile and portfolio-management tools such as Aha, Rally, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
* Demonstrated experience decomposing complex capabilities or features into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and drive alignment across multiple engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to understand and communicate end-to-end technical concepts, including data flows, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, or enterprise systems
* Demonstrated solid facilitation, written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, cross-team dependencies, and delivery risks

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare technology, healthcare payer operations, claims, prior authorization, clinical data, or managed-service platforms
* Experience operating within a scaled Agile or PI-planning environment
* Knowledge of cloud technologies, DevOps practices, integration testing, and automation
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHI

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

The Senior TPM must be able to understand the intended business and customer outcome, translate that need into manageable technical capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and remain actively engaged through planning, development, testing, release, and post-release validation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with disciplined product execution. This individual does not need to be the solution architect or engineering lead, but must be technically fluent enough to understand system interactions, integrations, APIs, data flows, dependencies, and technical constraints; ask the right questions; challenge assumptions; and facilitate alignment between business and technical teams.

A key measure of success in this role is the ability to turn complex or sometimes ambiguous business needs into well-understood, appropriately scoped work that engineering teams can execute predictably.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Translate strategy into executable work: Partner with Product Management to translate business, customer, and product needs into well-defined capabilities, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized technical work
* Own backlog readiness and work decomposition: Break complex initiatives into manageable increments, maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog, and ensure work is sufficiently defined and understood before entering development
* Partner closely with Engineering: Work day-to-day with onshore and offshore Engineering, Architecture, and QA teams to clarify requirements, evaluate technical approaches, understand APIs, integrations, data flows, and dependencies, and resolve questions throughout development
* Drive delivery across teams: Support sprint and PI planning, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and proactively manage scope, risks, blockers, and decisions from initial definition through development and delivery
* Ensure quality and release readiness: Partner with Engineering and QA on testing, acceptance criteria, UAT, release readiness, and deployment activities, ensuring product changes meet intended business and customer outcomes
* Communicate and continuously improve: Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and release impacts while identifying opportunities to improve requirements quality, delivery predictability, and collaboration across distributed teams
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
* 3+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, product management, business systems analysis, or technology delivery
* Experience working directly with engineering leadership, architects, and distributed development teams
* Experience supporting PI planning, dependency management, and scaled Agile delivery
* Experience managing and prioritizing backlogs in an Agile product-development environment
* Experience partnering directly with engineering teams to clarify requirements and drive work through planning and delivery
* Experience with Agile and portfolio-management tools such as Aha, Rally, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
* Demonstrated experience decomposing complex capabilities or features into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and drive alignment across multiple engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to understand and communicate end-to-end technical concepts, including data flows, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, or enterprise systems
* Demonstrated solid facilitation, written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, cross-team dependencies, and delivery risks

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare technology, healthcare payer operations, claims, prior authorization, clinical data, or managed-service platforms
* Experience operating within a scaled Agile or PI-planning environment
* Knowledge of cloud technologies, DevOps practices, integration testing, and automation
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHI

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
role: Product Owner: Market Maker & Options Clearing (VP)
role_title: Product Owner: Market Maker & Options Clearing (VP)
title: Product Owner: Market Maker & Options Clearing (VP)
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Business Execution Consultant, an experienced Product Owner (individual contributor) for planning, coordination, and delivering enhancements across Market Maker Clearing, Options Clearing, Trade Processing, Regulatory Reporting, Reconciliation, and Post-Trade Operations. The Product Owner manages product demand and the backlog, documents requirements, drives Agile delivery, coordinates stakeholders, leads testing and release readiness, and provides executive reporting to support successful execution of strategic, operational, and regulatory initiatives.

**In this role, you will:**

Lead delivery management activities for assigned product capabilities within the Securities and Prime Services organization, partnering with global product managers and technology teams to manage execution, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments.

**Functional and Technical Skills**

**Product Ownership**

* Execute the product roadmap across Market Maker Clearing, Options Clearing, Equity Clearing, Trade Processing, Reconciliation, Regulatory Reporting, and Post-Trade Operations.
* Evaluate business requests, operational needs, stakeholder feedback, control requirements, and regulatory obligations to prioritize the backlog and plan delivery.
* Manage the product demand and intake process, ensuring requests are documented, assessed, tracked, prioritized, and routed appropriately.
* Maintain visibility into product initiatives, outcomes, dependencies, milestones, capacity, risks, assumptions, and delivery commitments.
* Manage quarterly planning activities, including Big Room Planning (BRP), capacity reviews, dependency management, prioritization, and roadmap coordination.
* Partner with Product Managers to define intended outcomes, clarify scope and acceptance measures, evaluate solution options, and drive delivery from concept through implementation.
* Assess impacts across business processes, technology platforms, operating models, controls, regulatory reporting, and client or counterparty servicing.

**Agile Delivery and Requirements Management**

* Create, refine, and maintain Capabilities, Epics, Features, User Stories, business requirements, acceptance criteria, and process flows in Jira.
* Partner with Business Analysts and Technology teams to translate complex business and operational needs into clear, testable, and actionable work items.
* Own backlog refinement and prioritization; lead or support sprint planning, story reviews, retrospectives, backlog reviews, and daily scrum meetings as needed.
* Track delivery progress, resolve gaps, and identify and escalate risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies in a timely manner.
* Evaluate solution options and document impacts to clearing workflows, operational processes, controls, data, and downstream consumers.

**Testing, Release Readiness and Production Governance**

* Lead or coordinate user acceptance testing, test planning, traceability, evidence management, defect triage, production validation, and post-implementation reviews.
* Coordinate implementation planning, release readiness, stakeholder communications, training materials, rollout activities, support procedures, and production preparedness.
* Ensure processes, controls, support procedures, business continuity considerations, and target operating models are documented and validated before implementation.
* Support root cause analysis, incident remediation, production issues, audit and compliance requests, and sustainable corrective actions.

**Stakeholder Coordination and Governance**

* Coordinate Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Business, and Control stakeholders to drive delivery activities and decisions.
* Lead working sessions, planning meetings, governance reviews, execution checkpoints, and cross-workstream coordination.
* Maintain action, decision, issue, risk, assumption, and dependency logs; establish clear owners and drive timely resolution of blockers.
* Manage and respond to internal and external inquiries related to product capabilities, delivery commitments, controls, and ongoing initiatives.

**Process Improvement, Data, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and execute opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and scale product and operational processes.
* Use automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, improve delivery efficiency, and enhance decision-making.
* Develop dashboards, metrics, and management reporting covering roadmap delivery, testing, capacity, risks, controls, and operational readiness.
* Use AI-supported documentation, analysis, planning, testing, reporting, and communication judiciously, with appropriate review for accuracy, context, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

**Executive Communication**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with product specialists, clearing and operations teams, technology partners, control functions, and senior leaders across global businesses.
* Create concise, executive-ready presentations and updates that clearly explain business outcomes, delivery status, trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
* Translate complex clearing, platform, operational, and regulatory issues into clear, outcome-oriented conversations and practical recommendations.
* Build trusted relationships and strong communication channels across business, operations, product, technology, risk, compliance, and control partners.
* Influence without direct authority and drive alignment in a global, highly matrixed organization.

**Change Mindset, Collaboration and Ownership**

**About Vista Equity Partners**

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

**About Amtech**

Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.

With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.

**Our Employee Value Proposition**

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:

**Purpose**

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

**Growth**

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

**Culture**

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

**Innovation**

Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Sr Product Owner, based in Amtech India, to support product execution for our labeling ERP product line and to coordinate and support the product owners working across our labeling and corrugated ERP product lines.

On the product side, this role performs the product-management execution work for the labeling line of business in close partnership with in-market product leadership. Working with product management and market-facing stakeholders, the Senior Product Owner translates roadmap initiatives and projects into actionable development work, produces and maintains product artifacts, and drives delivery — while market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set jointly with in-market leadership.

On the coordination side, this role supports and oversees the product-owner process for the India-based team: scheduling and facilitating agile ceremonies, acting as a quality gate on product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts, and building a strong product-owner community of practice. This is a coordination and enablement role; it does not carry direct people-management responsibility.

The ideal candidate understands manufacturing operations, ERP systems, and agile product development, and is comfortable working across technical teams, product owners, and in-market product leadership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Product Execution (Labeling Product Line)**

* Perform product-management execution for the labeling product line in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Translate roadmap initiatives and projects into epics, user stories, and a well-formed backlog.

* Produce and maintain product artifacts, working with in-market leadership to close market-facing gaps.

* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes in line with roadmap direction set with in-market leadership.

* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan sprints across multiple months.

**Product Owner Coordination & Enablement (Both Product Lines)**

* Coordinate and support the product owners working across the labeling and corrugated product lines in India.

* Schedule, facilitate, and oversee agile ceremonies — Program Increment (PI) Planning, Sprint Planning, and Sprint Reviews.

* Review and act as a quality gate on the completeness and quality of PDLC artifacts.

* Build and support a product-owner community of practice — shared standards, templates, and continuous improvement.

* Help product owners grow in their craft through coaching, feedback, and shared best practices.

**Agile Development Collaboration**

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during sprint planning, development, and release cycles.

* Coordinate with product managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment planning.

* Participate in sprint ceremonies including planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

* Clarify requirements and ensure development teams understand the desired product outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work with in-market product leadership (product management and market-facing stakeholders) to align execution with roadmap and customer needs.

* Work with implementation, support, and sales teams to ensure product features align with customer needs.

* Provide product expertise for internal stakeholders and help drive continuous improvement of product capabilities.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7+ years experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst in a software environment, including experience leading or coordinating other product owners.

* Strong experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments and facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning.

* Experience with ERP systems.

* Strong experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining and reviewing product requirements.

* Demonstrated ability to set and uphold quality standards for product artifacts.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with distributed and in-market teams.

* Product backlog and requirements management

* Agile / Scrum facilitation and PI planning

* Product-owner coordination and enablement

* PDLC artifact quality and standards

* Stakeholder communication across distributed teams

* ERP / manufacturing domain

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with manufacturing, ERP, or scheduling applications.

* Knowledge of production operations, shop floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.

* Experience working in a distributed / offshore model in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Experience establishing or supporting a product-owner community of practice.
* Experience with tools such as Jira or similar backlog management systems.

**Why Join Amtech**

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for the Single Ingest Platform across linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and every other source type our datasets depend on.
* Own the speed and accuracy of getting partner data into Gracenote, from onboarding new sources to processing every update.
* Drive AI innovation so ingest scales to new sources, markets and metadata types with greater speed and efficiency, without adding manual processes.
* Ensure the platform is monitored for performance and breaks, so issues are caught and resolved before they affect downstream teams.
* Run ingest as a service, translating the needs of Dataset Product Managers, metadata factory teams and Delivery into a prioritized roadmap.
* Define and publish the platform's service levels and key metrics for speed, accuracy, reliability and cost, and use them to drive decisions.
* Work effectively across a globally distributed organization, with strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US and EU stakeholders.

 **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on platform, data or data integration products.
* Hands-on experience with data ingestion or integration at scale: onboarding external sources, handling format and schema changes, and monitoring data flows.
* Has applied AI or ML inside a product, not only for personal productivity. Examples include extraction, classification, anomaly detection or schema mapping. Can reason about confidence, error rates and when a human needs to step in.
* Actively uses LLMs in day-to-day product work to speed up analysis, automate repetitive PM tasks and make better decisions. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands-on IC work at a senior level. Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL and REST APIs, and able to write or LLM-assist your own Python or SQL scripts to answer product questions.
* Runs a product on a small set of input and output metrics, and delivers predictably against commitments in a structured, milestone-driven development process.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with TV and entertainment metadata, EPG data or content supply chains.

text:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for the Single Ingest Platform across linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and every other source type our datasets depend on.
* Own the speed and accuracy of getting partner data into Gracenote, from onboarding new sources to processing every update.
* Drive AI innovation so ingest scales to new sources, markets and metadata types with greater speed and efficiency, without adding manual processes.
* Ensure the platform is monitored for performance and breaks, so issues are caught and resolved before they affect downstream teams.
* Run ingest as a service, translating the needs of Dataset Product Managers, metadata factory teams and Delivery into a prioritized roadmap.
* Define and publish the platform's service levels and key metrics for speed, accuracy, reliability and cost, and use them to drive decisions.
* Work effectively across a globally distributed organization, with strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US and EU stakeholders.

 **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on platform, data or data integration products.
* Hands-on experience with data ingestion or integration at scale: onboarding external sources, handling format and schema changes, and monitoring data flows.
* Has applied AI or ML inside a product, not only for personal productivity. Examples include extraction, classification, anomaly detection or schema mapping. Can reason about confidence, error rates and when a human needs to step in.
* Actively uses LLMs in day-to-day product work to speed up analysis, automate repetitive PM tasks and make better decisions. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands-on IC work at a senior level. Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL and REST APIs, and able to write or LLM-assist your own Python or SQL scripts to answer product questions.
* Runs a product on a small set of input and output metrics, and delivers predictably against commitments in a structured, milestone-driven development process.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with TV and entertainment metadata, EPG data or content supply chains.
* Familiarity with industry metadata and feed standards such as CableLabs ADI, TV-Anytime, or MovieLabs MEC and Avails.
* Experience with near-real-time or event-driven data pipelines.
* Experience building partner-facing source specifications or self-service onboarding tools.

job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

If you aspire to be a part of a team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle this is the role for you.

As a Lending Product Owner in Wealth Management Solutions team, you will be an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value.

You will need to be outcome focused and foster an environment of continual innovation based on data interpretation, customer / stakeholder interviews and adopting latest digital technologies to enhance client experience and maximize profitability. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
* Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Owns, maintains, and develops a product backlog that enables development to support the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition
* Lead agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Leads the Product Testing Strategy & Release management strategy by working closely with Testing Centre of Excellence
* Lead, mentor, and support a team of product analyst/associates, fostering their growth and development.
* Facilitate collaboration and communication within the team and with other departments.
* Act as the primary point of contact for product-related queries and updates.
* Continuously improve processes to enhance productivity and product quality.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Graduate / Post-Graduate, with a minimum of 6 years of experience in Banking / Financial Services of which at least 3 should be in a similar role & profile.
* Expertise in defining, building out product strategy and roadmap and Strong prioritization skills
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle
* Data & Tech Literacy - Leverages data analytics and digital skills to create new insights and deliver well designed applications that together support business transformation
* Market & Product Knowledge - Demonstrates a thorough understanding of our products, systems and end to end processes, and keeps abreast of market and industry trends
* Continuous Improvement - Applies innovation and design thinking techniques to continually challenge and improve the efficiency, scale, and resilience of our operating platform
* Team management experience, leading a team of ICs and managers.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Influencing skills to manage a variety of stakeholders from different functions
* Team player who proactively shares knowledge and information within and outside the function

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.
